name: LDAP
label: LDAP / LDAPS directory
description: Search, compare, create, update, delete, rename on a customer LDAP directory via the JDK JNDI provider. LDAPS or StartTLS required; plain ldap:// only with allow_plain_ldap. Bind password is password-typed and never logged. Filter values and DN components built from input are escaped.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One LDAP operation. Set operation (or rely on config). Secrets stay in configurationParameters. Example operation: 'search'.

schema.label: filter
schema.description: Purpose: operator-authored RFC 4515 filter for search when not building from filter_attribute+filter_value. Example: '(uid=ada)'.

schema.label: filter_attribute
schema.description: Purpose: attribute type used to build an equality filter. Combined with filter_value; the value is escaped (RFC 4515). Example: 'uid'.

schema.label: filter_value
schema.description: Purpose: assertion value for a built equality filter. Escaped per RFC 4515 (* ( ) \ and NUL). Example: 'ada'.

schema.label: dn
schema.description: Purpose: operator-authored target DN for search base, compare, create, update, delete, rename. Prefer rdn_type+rdn_value when the value comes from input. Example: 'uid=ada,dc=example,dc=org'.

schema.label: rdn_type
schema.description: Purpose: RDN attribute type when assembling a DN from input. Value is escaped (RFC 4514). Example: 'uid'.

schema.label: rdn_value
schema.description: Purpose: RDN attribute value when assembling a DN from input. Escaped per RFC 4514. Example: 'ada'.

schema.label: parent_dn
schema.description: Purpose: parent DN appended after a built RDN. Falls back to config base_dn. Example: 'ou=people,dc=example,dc=org'.

schema.label: new_dn
schema.description: Purpose: destination DN for rename. Example: 'uid=ada-l,ou=people,dc=example,dc=org'.

schema.label: attributes
schema.description: Purpose: attribute map for create (Add) and update (Modify REPLACE). Values are strings or string lists. Example: {"objectClass":["inetOrgPerson"],"cn":"Ada"}.

schema.label: attribute
schema.description: Purpose: attribute type for compare. Example: 'employeeNumber'.

schema.label: value
schema.description: Purpose: assertion value for compare. Escaped per RFC 4515. Example: '42'.

schema.label: scope
schema.description: Purpose: search scope. EXACT accepted values: base | object | one | onelevel | sub (default). Example: 'sub'.

schema.label: return_attributes
schema.description: Purpose: attribute types to return on search. Empty means the server default. Example: ["cn","mail"].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result as JSON (`status`/`data`). Search returns entries/count/truncated; compare returns matched; create/update/delete/rename return dn. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Operation payload. search: {entries, count, truncated}. compare: {matched, dn}. create/update/delete: {dn}. rename: {dn, new_dn}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Which capability to run. EXACT accepted values: search | compare | create | update | delete | rename. Required. Example: 'search'.

configurationParameters.label: Url
configurationParameters.description: ldap:// or ldaps:// URL (RFC 4516). Required. Use ldaps:// or ldap:// with start_tls. Example: 'ldaps://dir.example.org:636'.

configurationParameters.label: Bind Password
configurationParameters.description: Bind password. Secret. Must stay type password; never logged or echoed.

configurationParameters.label: Start Tls
configurationParameters.description: Upgrade ldap:// with StartTLS before bind. Default true. Ignored for ldaps://.

configurationParameters.label: Allow Plain Ldap
configurationParameters.description: Permit cleartext ldap:// without StartTLS. Default false. Lab only.

configurationParameters.label: Base Dn
configurationParameters.description: Default search base and parent DN when input omits dn / parent_dn.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read / search timeLimit in seconds. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Capped at 60.
